This series of various consecutive '''wars and conflicts''' occurred between the [[Psadan]] and the [[Myneyrsh]], two native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], before and into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] second wave of expansion. The cycle of violence would end somewhere during that time when [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists crash-landed on the planet. They lorded over the two primitive species with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. After a few generations, the Humans' [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] faded and, without their technological weaponry, were forced to take up [[Bow/Legends|bows]] to defend themselves. The [[Wayland colonial war|three-sided conflict]] was equalized. Eventually, the three groups would achieve peace.
